title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Vest on 1970-06-13
lineage: SBD MR > R > D > CD + AUD low-gen

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording of fair quality captures a hot‑summer Hawaii show with a smoking Easy Wind and standout New Speedway, but the mix is uneven and at times distracting.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – Phil’s driving bass on Easy Wind, razor‑sharp drumming and inspired versions of New Speedway, Good Lovin' and Me & My Uncle make this a memorable 1970 show.  The source is a clobbered matrix (SBD + audience) that swings from muddy AUD to crystal‑clear SBD, leaving the overall sound at best fair and often harsh.  Listeners who can look past the inconsistent mix will enjoy the high energy and historic vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers love the musical performance (many 4‑5 star comments) but repeatedly criticize the recording/mix, resulting in a middling overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix alternates between muddy audience (AUD) and clear soundboard (SBD); many note hiss, static, snare buzz and uneven instrument balance.  Some sections are praised as crystal‑clear, but overall the recording is described as ugly, off‑and‑on, or “dank” rather than pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans note an inspired, high‑energy Hawaiian vacation set with strong jams, but the fragmented source makes the flow feel disjointed; a guest keyboard appears mid‑show and track order confusion (duplicate Easy Wind/Uncle John) adds to the mess.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Often pushed back in the mix, sometimes barely audible; some reviewers note his guitar is backgrounded for much of the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for a hard‑driving bass line on Easy Wind and highlighted as a key reason to study this recording.
band_member_comments.Bob: His rhythm guitar and vocal presence are mixed high at times, described as leading the jam in certain sections.
band_member_comments.Keys: A guest keyboard is heard during New Speedway; reviewers anticipate Keith’s later appearance but note it isn’t present here.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers are called razor‑sharp by some, yet others hear a tap‑in‑the‑background snare buzz and overall weak drum presence.
